p0_final_tightening_specifications.title: Live downstream ingestion evidence generated by real reading code
p0_final_tightening_specifications.detail: Wired bulk.py / pipeline.py and scrna_smoke.py to generate live ingestion_evidence directly during data parsing. Evidence binds run_id, generated_at timestamp, route, exact input SHA-256 hashes, sample identities, and unnormalized raw_dimensions. Test test_real_local_ingestion_produces_accepted_manifests executes both actual entrypoints locally and proves they pass strict dual-route acceptance without mock manifest synthesis.

p0_final_tightening_specifications.title: Strict file-to-hash binding eliminating loose values() matching
p0_final_tightening_specifications.detail: In check_downstream_consumed, each target file (including bulk counts matrix and 10x matrix/barcodes/features triad) must be explicitly mapped by filename or resolved path to its exact SHA-256. A correct hash placed under an unrelated key fails immediately.

p0_final_tightening_specifications.title: Exact dimension reconciliation against upstream declared counts
p0_final_tightening_specifications.detail: Downstream manifests must report both feature/gene and sample/cell dimensions (reporting only n_cells fails). Actual read-in dimensions are compared element-by-element against upstream check values (mismatch like 1x1 vs 71x88 fails).

p0_final_tightening_specifications.title: Preserved delivery_allowed boolean false and dual-route requirement
p0_final_tightening_specifications.detail: delivery_allowed must be strictly boolean False (strings or omitted fail). Acceptance requires both salmon (bulk) and starsolo (scRNA) routes by default.
